heroHeadline: First EJVM+ Ceasefire Mission Heads to Minembwe as Bapere ADF Toll Tops 2,400
heroSubtitle: The Doha peace process reaches its first field test as an EJVM+ verification mission is due in Minembwe, South Kivu, following the Aug 22 Geneva roadmap agreement — even as local civil society in North Kivu's Bapere sector says ADF/ISCAP fighters have killed more than 2,400 civilians since mid-2024.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
